issue_context.title: Drop support for dump V1
issue_context.body: @meilisearch/docs-team and @meilisearch/integration-team (for the migration script). Validated with @gmourier, no spec are needed here. ------ MeiliSearch > 0.25 will drop support for dumps version 1. This concerns MeiliSearch with versions before v0.21 (v0.21 not included). Meilisearch has evolved a lot since then, and it is becoming harder and harder to maintain non-breaking dumps over so many versions. This is part of a process of stabilization, where eventually dumps will not break anymore. If you need to import a dump for a version < v0.21, you will first need to import it to a version between v0.21 and v0.25, and re-export it to newer engine versions. Ex: You are using MeiliSearch v0.20.0 and you want to upgrade to MeiliSearch v0.25.0. Here are the steps: - Create a dump using MeiliSearch v0.20.0 - Start MeiliSearch v0.24.0 by importing the previous dump - Create a dump using MeiliSearch v0.24.0 you just have launched - Start MeiliSearch v0.25.0 by importing the dump created using v0.24.0 What will happen if you try to import a dump created in v0.20.0 into MeiliSearch v0.25.0 and later:
